content.short: Snapshot Subgraph indexes on-chain governance events for Snapshot's governance data using a standardized GraphQL API.
content.description: Snapshot Subgraph is an indexing tool that exposes a uniform GraphQL API for querying on-chain data from the Snapshot protocol. Developers can fetch proposals, voting activity, and governance events that occur within Snapshot’s decentralized, multi-governance framework. By providing a structured, queryable view of governance data, the Subgraph enables dapps to retrieve and analyze governance activity, helping users gain insights into proposal trajectories, turnout, and decision outcomes. This tool supports building analytics and governance-oriented features that reflect how the Snapshot ecosystem evolves.
